cat > /tmp/repro.py << 'EOF'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pickle

fig = plt.figure()
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(211)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(212)
time=[0,1,2,3,4]
speed=[40000,4300,4500,4700,4800]
acc=[10,11,12,13,14]
ax1.plot(time,speed)
ax1.set_ylabel('speed')
ax2.plot(time,acc)
ax2.set_ylabel('acc')

fig.align_labels()

data = pickle.dumps(fig)
fig2 = pickle.loads(data)
print("OK", fig2)
EOF
